Name: chalk-fixture-managed-release
Content:
{
  "schemaVersion": "2.2",
  "description": "Deploy an immutable Chalk managed Episode release with the versioned host controller.",
  "parameters": {
    "SourceRevision": {
      "type": "String",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^[0-9a-f]{40}$",
      "minChars": 40,
      "maxChars": 40
    },
    "ManifestBase64": {
      "type": "String",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$",
      "minChars": 1,
      "maxChars": 48000
    },
    "ReleaseId": {
      "type": "String",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:@+=-]{0,127}$",
      "minChars": 1,
      "maxChars": 128
    },
    "Environment": {
      "type": "String",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$",
      "minChars": 1,
      "maxChars": 63
    },
    "AwsRegion": {
      "type": "String",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$",
      "minChars": 1,
      "maxChars": 32
    },
    "ParameterPrefix": {
      "type": "String",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*$",
      "minChars": 2,
      "maxChars": 900
    },
    "ExcludedSecrets": {
      "type": "String",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^\\[[A-Za-z0-9_.,\"-]*\\]$",
      "minChars": 2,
      "maxChars": 4096
    },
    "AdoptExistingRelease": {
      "type": "String",
      "default": "false",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedValues": ["true", "false"]
    },
    "RequestId": {
      "type": "String",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:@+=-]{0,127}$",
      "minChars": 1,
      "maxChars": 128
    },
    "RequestedAt": {
      "type": "String",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(?:\\.[0-9]{1,9})?Z$",
      "minChars": 20,
      "maxChars": 30
    },
    "ControllerVersion": {
      "type": "String",
      "default": "2",
      "interpolationType": "ENV_VAR",
      "allowedPattern": "^2$",
      "minChars": 1,
      "maxChars": 1
    }
  },
  "mainSteps": [
    {
      "action": "aws:runShellScript",
      "name": "deployRelease",
      "precondition": {
        "StringEquals": ["platformType", "Linux"]
      },
      "inputs": {
        "runCommand": [
          "#!/bin/bash",
          "set -euo pipefail",
          "umask 077",
          "for required_command in awk base64 curl find jq mktemp tar; do command -v \"$required_command\" >/dev/null || { printf 'missing required host command: %s\\n' \"$required_command\" >&2; exit 1; }; done",
          "work_root=\"$(mktemp -d /run/chalk-ssm.XXXXXX)\"",
          "cleanup() { case \"$work_root\" in /run/chalk-ssm.??????) find \"$work_root\" -depth -delete ;; *) printf 'refusing unsafe SSM work cleanup\\n' >&2 ;; esac; }",
          "trap cleanup EXIT",
          "archive=\"$work_root/source.tar.gz\"",
          "source_root=\"$work_root/source\"",
          "mkdir -m 0700 \"$source_root\"",
          "curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --output \"$archive\" \"https://github.com/Q9Labs/chalk/archive/$SSM_SourceRevision.tar.gz\"",
          "tar --extract --gzip --file \"$archive\" --directory \"$source_root\" --strip-components=1",
          "manifest=\"$work_root/release-manifest.json\"",
          "printf '%s' \"$SSM_ManifestBase64\" | base64 --decode >\"$manifest\"",
          "chmod 0600 \"$manifest\"",
          "request=\"$work_root/deployment-request.json\"",
          "jq -n --arg release_id \"$SSM_ReleaseId\" --arg source_revision \"$SSM_SourceRevision\" --arg environment \"$SSM_Environment\" --arg aws_region \"$SSM_AwsRegion\" --arg parameter_prefix \"$SSM_ParameterPrefix\" --arg request_id \"$SSM_RequestId\" --arg requested_at \"$SSM_RequestedAt\" --argjson controller_version \"$SSM_ControllerVersion\" --argjson adopt_existing_release \"$SSM_AdoptExistingRelease\" --argjson excluded_secrets \"$SSM_ExcludedSecrets\" '{schema_version:2,controller_version:$controller_version,adopt_existing_release:$adopt_existing_release,release_id:$release_id,source_revision:$source_revision,environment:$environment,aws_region:$aws_region,parameter_prefix:$parameter_prefix,excluded_secrets:$excluded_secrets,request_id:$request_id,requested_at:$requested_at}' >\"$request\"",
          "chmod 0600 \"$request\"",
          "controller=\"$source_root/infrastructure/managed-episode/controller/chalk-deployment-controller\"",
          "test -f \"$controller\" && test ! -L \"$controller\"",
          "controller_relative=\"controller/chalk-deployment-controller\"",
          "expected_controller_sha=\"$(jq -er --arg path \"$controller_relative\" '.runtime_artifacts[$path] | select(type == \"string\" and test(\"^[0-9a-f]{64}$\"))' \"$manifest\")\"",
          "if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then actual_controller_sha=\"$(sha256sum \"$controller\" | awk '{print $1}')\"; elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then actual_controller_sha=\"$(shasum -a 256 \"$controller\" | awk '{print $1}')\"; else printf 'missing required SHA-256 command\\n' >&2; exit 1; fi",
          "test \"$actual_controller_sha\" = \"$expected_controller_sha\" || { printf 'controller digest does not match release manifest\\n' >&2; exit 1; }",
          "chmod 0755 \"$controller\"",
          "\"$controller\" deploy --request \"$request\" --manifest \"$manifest\" --source-root \"$source_root\""
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
